exposure: Severe ICP (≥40 μmol/L total bile acids)
mild ICP (10 μmol/L < total bile acids < 40 μmol/L)
Mild ICP (10 μmol/L < total bile acids < 40 μmol/L)
cohort: 227 nulliparous women with a singleton fetus complicated by ICP
finding: Severe ICP and preeclampsia are associated with a higher incidence of AFOs.
mod_finding: Women with severe ICP had a significantly higher incidence of planned and unplanned CS compared with mild ICP subjects.
